WITH reaped AS (
                       UPDATE mailbox.messages m
                          SET dead_lettered_at = now()
                        WHERE m.to_session_id IS NOT NULL
                          AND m.sent_request_id IS NULL
                          AND m.channel_delivered_at IS NULL
                          AND m.consumed_at IS NULL
                          AND m.dead_lettered_at IS NULL
                          AND m.queued_at < $1
                          AND NOT EXISTS (
                              SELECT 1
                                FROM requests.requests r
                               WHERE r.session_id = m.to_session_id
                                 AND r.created_at >= $2
                          )
                    RETURNING m.message_uuid, m.from_session_id, m.to_session_id
                   ),
                   notices AS (
                       INSERT INTO mailbox.messages (message_uuid, to_session_id, from_session_id, body)
                       SELECT gen_random_uuid(), r.from_session_id, NULL,
                              '[mike mail] Not delivered: your message ' || r.message_uuid::text
                              || ' to session ' || s.session_uuid::text
                              || ' was given up on (the session made no request in time). mike delivers it again when that session next makes a request.'
                         FROM reaped r
                         JOIN sessions.sessions s ON s.id = r.to_session_id
                        WHERE r.from_session_id IS NOT NULL
                    RETURNING id
                   )
                   INSERT INTO mailbox.failed_sends
                       (attempted_by_session_id, attempted_to, reason, request_id)
                   SELECT r.from_session_id, s.session_uuid::text, 'strand_ttl_expired', NULL
                     FROM reaped r
                     JOIN sessions.sessions s ON s.id = r.to_session_id
                   RETURNING id
